edit.description: the queue-wide forest read, where the parent cycle is already refused
the cycle refusal and the dangling-blocker admission beside it

summary: a queue whose `blockedBy` edges close a cycle is refused at the read, rather than parsed into entries that are reported queued and can never be picked
acceptance: a queue carrying a `blockedBy` cycle is refused like any malformed queue, naming the entries the cycle runs through, while a `blockedBy` naming a tag no entry carries still parses
tests: a queue whose blockedBy edges form a cycle is refused naming the entries in it
a queue whose blockedBy cycle runs through three entries names all three
pins: a blockedBy naming a tag no entry in the queue carries is admitted
notes: `queueForestErrors` refuses a `parent` cycle and nothing refuses `A blockedBy B, B blockedBy A`: the queue parses, `flume status` reports both entries, both walks in `harness/order.ts` are guarded, and the only signal is that neither ever ships. The walk the parent check already runs is the home. Shares `src/PendingSchema.ts` with THE-RENDERED-SCHEMA-STATES-THE-FOREST-RULES-THE-PARSE-ENFORCES.
